we have identified a number of novel compounds with novel modes of actions that target metabolic pathways required by Mtb to survive and grow within macrophages.

The main takeaway from our work is that
the intracellular environment constrains Mtb’s metabolism, thereby limiting the metabolic pathways that can be targeted by drugs.
cholesterol is a unique carbon source that imposes a novel form of metabolic constraint on Mtb.

cholesterol utilization in M. tuberculosis is constrained by its intracellular environment, which is consistent with the notion that the bacterium is not optimized for growth on cholesterol as the principle source of carbon and energy.
